title: Slow command logging: Prometheus histograms and configurable threshold
description: Expose nntp_command_duration_seconds{command} and jmap_method_duration_seconds{method} Prometheus histograms. Always recorded regardless of threshold. [log] slow_command_threshold_ms config field (default 1000, 0=disable WARN events, histogram still records). Blocked on: stoa-73bdf558.
